title: spec/08: fix decoy protected-header bytes in handoff examples
description: spec/08-gateway-coordination.md:295,334 label h'a10139ffff' as {1: -65537}; those bytes are actually {1: -65536} (5 bytes), which the C verifier treats as the decoy. The correct {1: -65537} encoding is the 7-byte a1 01 3a 00 01 00 00. Fix the examples and any prose derived from them. Doc bug only.
